rounds.notes:
## Power

In Round 1, you should get [Optimizer](item_13d41c37-8f79-4435-9d81-c9599955f6a8). This power will heal you and your teammates for more when using a Repair Pack. This item scales with Max Life and is not only good for survivability, but also for farming Stadium Cash.

## Items

As for items, in the earlier rounds you should focus on building [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) and Armor. You should get [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6), [Charged Plating](item_b8ca58e7-6ae2-40ee-8618-fe2f32315295) and [Power Playbook](item_6d8803cf-baa7-46ee-af91-51e7f2301418).

## Items

In Round 2, you should get [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8), unless it's one of the only items you can afford. Otherwise, get some cheap items that give Health. [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) is an insanely strong item on [Brigitte](hero_8d4e7c27-fb70-4694-9721-2ecf094ef84a), as it gives [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) and a crazy amount of survivability. [Brigitte](hero_8d4e7c27-fb70-4694-9721-2ecf094ef84a) is very reliant on her cooldowns and she has so many of them.

## Power

In Round 3, you get to pick another power and I usually go for [Lindholm Wall](item_a733a6f5-72cd-43cd-a0fd-b1e03fa34753). This power will make your Barrier Shield bigger and stronger.

## Items

You should be able to afford [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) and [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) now. Otherwise, fill the rest of your slots with cheap items that give Health. [Brigitte](hero_8d4e7c27-fb70-4694-9721-2ecf094ef84a)'s Rocket Flail counts as [Melee Damage](stat_melee_damage) for [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) and will give you Armor, [Move Speed](stat_move_speed) and restore Max Life, making you even more tanky.

## Items

In Round 4, you should get [Scavenged Steel](item_fb9d2d13-db05-46fa-b3c6-07495b1872a4), which will give you Armor, [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction) and allow you to farm your ultimate faster. This item also has synergy with [Charged Plating](item_b8ca58e7-6ae2-40ee-8618-fe2f32315295). Fill the rest of your slots with cheap items that give Health.

## Power

In Round 5, you should get [Aura Farming](item_b2416f42-1aa6-440a-8080-86290f5556c0), which will later synergize with [Consecrated Ground](item_fbdd3ee7-e527-4549-8dda-796c428270ee). Your Inspire will continue to lose value in the later rounds, so a power like [Aura Farming](item_b2416f42-1aa6-440a-8080-86290f5556c0) that scales with Max Life will be very useful.

## Items

Get [Rustung Von Wilhelm](item_aea17a63-3f55-4f91-8f49-a7793fbc56c4) to become even more tanky. [Rustung Von Wilhelm](item_aea17a63-3f55-4f91-8f49-a7793fbc56c4) will increase your Armor and Health by 15%, while also giving you 10% damage reduction below 30% Life. Fill the rest of your slots with cheap items that give Health.

## Items

In Round 6, you should be able to afford either [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98) or [Hardlight Weave](item_0e674b2f-4048-4fc9-be6d-95d51d2ae33b). [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98) will give you constant Health regeneration that scales with Max Life and [Hardlight Weave](item_0e674b2f-4048-4fc9-be6d-95d51d2ae33b) will make your Barrier Shield stronger. Fill the rest of your slots with cheap items that give Health.

## Power

In Round 7, you should go for either [Consecrated Ground](item_fbdd3ee7-e527-4549-8dda-796c428270ee) or [Mender Bender](item_df95cea8-7040-4bfc-9145-8b820edce5a3) to synergize with [Aura Farming](item_b2416f42-1aa6-440a-8080-86290f5556c0). [Consecrated Ground](item_fbdd3ee7-e527-4549-8dda-796c428270ee) will make your ultimate even stronger, while [Mender Bender](item_df95cea8-7040-4bfc-9145-8b820edce5a3) will activate [Aura Farming](item_b2416f42-1aa6-440a-8080-86290f5556c0) and heal Barrier Shield Health every time you use Shield Bash. [Burst Aid](item_a676ca4f-264e-46b1-8a4a-9aa732b95eae)  is another option, but I'm personally not the biggest fan of it.

## Items

As for the last item, you should be able to afford either [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98) or [Hardlight Weave](item_0e674b2f-4048-4fc9-be6d-95d51d2ae33b), depending on which one you picked in Round 6. Otherwise, go for any cheaper item that gives Health. [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016) pairs really well with [Hardlight Weave](item_0e674b2f-4048-4fc9-be6d-95d51d2ae33b).
